snippet.title: Immerguest The Veiled Inn Demo Trailer
snippet.description:
Immerguest – The Veiled Inn is a dark turn-based party RPG where three heroes venture through branching runs, build powerful synergies with Mods and Tarot, master Flow and timed dodges, and face deadly encounters beyond a mysterious inn.

The playable demo is coming soon on Steam.

Wishlist Immerguest – The Veiled Inn on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4662550...

Check out the Demo on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/5124270...

Build your Flow by chaining different actions, generate Overflow with Basic Actions, and react to enemy attacks with precisely timed dodges.

Shape each run with Skill Mods and Tarot cards, choose your path through branching encounters, and prepare your party for dangerous elites and bosses beyond the mist.

Features

Tactical turn-based party combat
Real-time timed dodge mechanics
Three playable heroes: Haldor, Selena and Lyria
Flow, Flow Strikes and Overflow
Skill Mods and Tarot cards
Branching paths, events and elite encounters
Dark fantasy atmosphere
Challenging boss encounters

Developed by Alexander Jayakumaran / RAWR Games

#Immerguest #TurnBasedRPG #IndieGame
